meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 能帮你浏览、选择并提交 Ginkgo Bioworks 云实验室的自动化实验方案，包括蛋白表达纯化、定量检测、RNA 合成、热稳定性分析等，还能通过 EstiMate 询问定制方案的价格和可行性。
howto.when: 当你想在 Ginkgo 云实验室运行蛋白表达、定量检测、RNA 合成、热稳定性分析、Echo-MS 方法、SPR 靶点或荧光像素画等实验，或者需要了解方案价格和订购流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看有哪些细胞-free蛋白表达方案？
say.note: Claude 会列出相关方案及价格、周期。

say.text: 我想做IVT mRNA合成，需要准备什么？
say.note: Claude 会说明输入要求和订购步骤。

say.text: 用EstiMate评估一个定制蛋白纯化方案。
say.note: Claude 会引导你描述需求并获取报价。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can help you browse, select, and submit protocols for Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab, including protein expression/purification, quantification, RNA synthesis, thermal shift assays, and more. It also supports custom workflow estimation via EstiMate.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to run protein expression, quantification, RNA synthesis, thermal shift, Echo-MS, SPR, or pixel art experiments on Ginkgo Cloud Lab, or need pricing and ordering guidance.

say_en.text: Show me cell-free protein expression options.
say_en.note: Claude lists protocols with price and turnaround.

say_en.text: What do I need for IVT mRNA synthesis?
say_en.note: Claude explains inputs and ordering steps.

say_en.text: Estimate a custom purification workflow via EstiMate.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to describe needs and get a quote.
